lines.q: Which has more people, the United States or Indonesia?
lines.a: The United States! About three hundred forty three million, sixty million more.
The Philippines! About one hundred fifteen million, thirty million more than Germany.
Russia! About one hundred forty five million, but Ethiopia is catching up fast.
Mexico! About one hundred thirty million. Think you can get all four? Go again!
